text:
Sam Iyer: :wave: Morning — quick all-hands async check. What I did: merged the model-router perf PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-router/pull/412) and ran a short staging smoke run; seeing ~12% p99 drop. Blockers: flaky e2e failing intermittently on CI, need help triaging.

deply-bot: deploy-bot: Heads up — starting canary rollout for model-router:v1.4-canary at 11:30 UTC.

Anya Patel: Nice work on the perf numbers. I'll watch canary metrics. For the e2e flaky, I can pair after standup — @Chris Liao can you spare ~20m?

Chris Liao: Yup, I’m free at 11:10 UTC. Suspect KV cache eviction race. Adding extra logging to the test harness now; linking draft fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-router/pull/431

Izzy Moreno: Infra note — dedicated autoscaler spiked briefly overnight, alert fired but normalized. No customer impact. I’ll post graphs in #eng-infra with timestamps.

Lindsey Park: Docs update for rollout policies landed (PR #78). Small ask: can someone glance and approve?

Sam Iyer: @Lindsey I’ll review by EOD. Also small ask for the research/evals folks: we need more long-context samples for the eval suite (16k+). If you have anonymised logs, please drop them in s3://redwood-eval-samples/long-context/ or DM me.

Anya Patel: To reproduce the e2e locally you can run: ```docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm e2e pytest tests/test_long_request.py::test_prefix_cache``` You might need `REDWOOD_CACHE_SIZE=256` in env.

Chris Liao: Confirmed reproduce locally with that command. Pushed hotfix to PR #431 to guard against nil KV reads. Will open small follow-up to improve coverage.

deply-bot: deploy-bot: Canary at 50% traffic, no error lift detected so far.

Sam Iyer: Thanks — tiny ask: can product/PM confirm acceptance criteria for the canary before we advance to 100%? @Anya @Izzy

Anya Patel: Will sync with PM and post acceptance notes here by 12:00 UTC.

Lindsey Park: Reviewed docs, left one inline comment. :thumbsup:

Izzy Moreno: FYI I’m OOO tomorrow morning until 14:00 PT. If alerts spike, please ping #eng-sre. Link to autoscaler graph: https://grafana.redwood/graph/123

Sam Iyer: Great — if no other blockers I’ll close this thread. Thanks all :rocket:
